Show less Read more Like 6 Dislike Reply @gbrann1 9 months ago Thank you for actually reviewing this device. There are so many Apple reviewed products on You Tube understandably so but since this device hit stores a month ago, there has barely been a legitimate review online, just a few influencers that Microsoft invited to the unveiling in early May to likely Apple users. So it's refreshing to see someone truly review this device. I'm a long time Surface user who've had Surface Pro 3, Surface Book, Surface Duo 1 & 2, Surface Laptop Studio and now Surface Laptop with Snapdragon X Elite 32gb and have been wondering if I replace my 12.9 inch iPad Pro M1 with the Surface Pro 12. I'm excited about iPad OS 26 but it looks like you still can't have multiple audio playing at the same time but wanted to wait until the public beta is released to install it and then decide if I should keep it or trade it in towards the purchase of the Surface Pro 12 to offset the cost. Having said all of that, I appreciate the great effort in actually reviewing this device and providing some variety in a sea of tech reviewers who review every product through Apple lens. You have a new subscriber in me. Show less Read more Like 13 Dislike ❤ by @thao Reply 1 reply Hide replies 1 reply @yoshicube64 9 months ago Happy to always see a video from Thao!
